title: PRNet Runner integration
description: Explicitly started registered PRNet run; independent source snapshot and artifacts.

evaluation.implementation: PRNet original four-output BCE+IoU training; test sums logits, resizes to mask size, sigmoid and per-image min-max normalization. Metrics extracted from original epoch log; loss rounded to four decimals.

metrics.definition: Original logged mean of four BCE+IoU losses, rounded to four decimals.
metrics.name: loss

metrics.definition: Original test script per-image normalized prediction MAE averaged over the configured test set.
metrics.name: mae
